title: Japanese Chicken Tagine
description: A Japanese twist on traditional Moroccan cuisine, this dish combines the flavors of chicken, Japanese soy sauce, and tagine spices. The result is a delicious and aromatic meal that is sure to impress.
instructions: Heat butter in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add soy sauce, tagine spice blend, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 10-12 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in green onions and serve hot.
Garnish with additional green onions, if desired.
